diseases.name: Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
diseases.def: A bacterial infection occurring in any part of the urinary system, including the kidneys, ureters, bladder, or urethra.
symptoms: Pain in the side, abdomen, pelvic area, or lower back
Pressure or discomfort in the lower pelvis
Pain or a burning sensation when urinating
Difficulty controlling the urge to urinate
Mental changes or confusion (in severe cases)

diseases.name: Malaria
diseases.def: A serious, life-threatening parasitic disease caused by Plasmodium parasites and transmitted to humans through the bites of infected female Anopheles mosquitoes.
symptoms: Early Symptoms: Fever, headache, chills (feeling cold and shivering)
Severe Symptoms: Extreme tiredness, impaired consciousness, convulsions (sudden seizures), difficulty breathing, dark or bloody urine, jaundice (yellow skin and eyes), abnormal bleeding

diseases.name: Stomach Flu (Viral Gastroenteritis)
diseases.def: An intestinal infection caused by viruses (such as norovirus or rotavirus) that leads to inflammation of the stomach and intestines.

diseases.name: Chickenpox
diseases.def: A highly contagious viral infection caused by the varicella-zoster virus, characterized by an itchy, blister-like skin rash.
symptoms: Itchy rash (red spots developing into fluid-filled blisters)

diseases.name: Asthma
diseases.def: A chronic respiratory condition in which the airways narrow, swell, and produce extra mucus, making breathing difficult.
symptoms: Wheezing (a whistling or squeaking sound when breathing)
Cough (especially at night or triggered by exercise)

diseases.name: Typhoid Fever
diseases.def: A systemic bacterial infection caused by Salmonella enterica serotype Typhi, typically spread through contaminated food and water.
symptoms: Fever (starting gradually and getting progressively higher over several days)
Rose spots rash (faint pink spots on the chest or stomach)
Nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea or constipation

diseases.name: Hepatitis A
diseases.def: A highly contagious liver infection caused by the hepatitis A virus (HAV), primarily transmitted through the ingestion of contaminated food or water or close contact with an infected person.
symptoms: Jaundice (yellowing of the skin and whites of the eyes)
Gastrointestinal distress (nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite)
Abdominal discomfort (pain in upper right quadrant over the liver)
Systemic signs (fatigue, low-grade fever, joint or muscle pain)
Excretory changes (dark amber urine, pale or clay-colored stools)

diseases.name: Common Cold
diseases.def: A mild, contagious viral infection of the upper respiratory tract (nose and throat) most commonly caused by rhinoviruses.
symptoms: Early Stage (Days 1-3): Tickle or sore throat, sneezing, runny or stuffy nose, cough, hoarseness
Active Stage (Days 4-7): Body aches, headache, runny eyes, fatigue, occasional fever

diseases.name: Pneumonia
diseases.def: An acute respiratory infection that inflames the air sacs (alveoli) in one or both lungs, causing them to fill with fluid or pus.
symptoms: Coughing up yellow, green, or bloody mucus
Breathing fast or feeling short of breath
Sharp chest or belly pain (especially when coughing or taking a deep breath)
Bluish color in the skin, lips, or nails

diseases.name: Measles
diseases.def: A highly contagious respiratory disease caused by the measles virus that spreads through respiratory droplets and causes a characteristic full-body rash.
symptoms: Koplik spots (small white spots inside the cheeks)
Red skin rash starting on face and spreading throughout body

diseases.name: Influenza (The Flu)
diseases.def: A contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses that infect the nose, throat, and sometimes the lungs.

diseases.name: Tuberculosis (TB)
diseases.def: A potentially serious infectious bacterial disease caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis that primarily affects the lungs and spreads through the air via coughs or sneezes.
symptoms: Active TB (Lungs): Cough lasting 3 weeks or longer, coughing up blood or mucus, chest pain/pain when breathing, fever and chills, night sweats, unexplained weight loss, fatigue
Active TB (Outside Lungs): Localized pain, fevers, night sweats, weight loss depending on infected area

diseases.name: Diabetes Mellitus
diseases.def: A group of chronic metabolic disorders characterized by persistently high blood sugar (glucose) levels resulting from defects in insulin production, insulin action, or both.
symptoms: Type 1 Diabetes: Extreme thirst, frequent urination, increased hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue and weakness, blurred vision
Type 2 Diabetes: Increased thirst, frequent urination, fatigue, blurred vision, slow-healing wounds, numbness/tingling in hands and feet
Gestational Diabetes: Often no symptoms, increased thirst, frequent urination, fatigue

diseases.name: Dengue
diseases.def: A mosquito-borne viral infection caused by the dengue virus (DENV) and transmitted primarily by female Aedes aegypti mosquitoes.
symptoms: Standard Symptoms: High fever, nausea and vomiting, rash, eye pain, muscle/joint/bone pain
Severe Dengue Warning Signs: Severe abdominal pain, frequent vomiting, bleeding from nose/gums or blood in vomit/stool, extreme tiredness or restlessness

diseases.name: High Blood Pressure (Hypertension)
diseases.def: A chronic medical condition in which the force of blood pushing against the walls of the arteries is consistently too high, increasing the risk of heart disease and stroke.
symptoms: Hypertensive Emergency Symptoms: Severe headache, chest pain, confusion, dizziness, vision changes, heart palpitations, shortness of breath or stroke signs

diseases.name: COVID-19
diseases.def: A highly contagious respiratory illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus.
symptoms: Shortness of breath or difficulty breathing
New loss of taste or smell

diseases.name: Hepatitis B
diseases.def: A serious liver infection caused by the hepatitis B virus (HBV) that can become chronic and lead to liver failure, cirrhosis, or liver cancer.
symptoms: Jaundice (yellowing of the skin and eyes)

diseases.name: Bronchitis
diseases.def: Inflammation of the lining of the bronchial tubes, which carry air to and from the lungs.

diseases.name: Gastritis
diseases.def: Inflammation, irritation, or erosion of the lining of the stomach.
symptoms: Gnawing or burning ache or pain in your upper abdomen
Feeling of fullness in your upper abdomen after eating

diseases.name: Kidney Stones
diseases.def: Hard deposits made of minerals and salts that form inside your kidneys.
symptoms: Severe pain in the side and back, below the ribs
Pain that radiates to the lower abdomen and groin
Pain that comes in waves and fluctuates in intensity
Pain or burning sensation while urinating
